title.zh: 数字没有说谎，结论却错了
title.en: Every Number Was True, and the Conclusion Was Still Wrong

desc.zh: 九种让真数字推出假结论的方式：均值回归、小样本、幸存者、多重比较、辛普森悖论、基础比率、相对风险、长尾平均和古德哈特定律。每一种都配一个小模型，先亲手造出错觉，再亲手关掉它。
desc.en: Nine ways true numbers lead to false conclusions: regression to the mean, small samples, survivorship, many comparisons, Simpson's paradox, base rates, relative risk, long-tailed averages and Goodhart's law. Each comes with a small model: produce the illusion yourself, then switch it off.

desc.zh: 按一次成绩挑出来的极端者，下一次会向平均靠拢，什么都不做也一样。
desc.en: People picked for an extreme score drift back toward the average next time, even if nothing is done to them.

zh: 为什么考得最差的下次进步

desc.zh: 样本越小平均数摆得越厉害，排行榜的两头都挤满小样本。
desc.en: The smaller the sample, the more its average swings, so both ends of any league table fill with small samples.

desc.zh: 失败者从数据里消失，留下来的平均值就会好看，哪怕谁都没本事。
desc.en: When failures drop out of the data, the average of what is left looks good even if nobody had any skill.

desc.zh: 检验做得够多，巧合的「显著」迟早出现，只报告那一个就是在挑运气。
desc.en: Run enough tests and a chance 'significant' result turns up; reporting only that one is picking luck.

zh: 试了二十次总有一次显著

title.zh: 辛普森悖论与混杂因素

desc.zh: 各组人员构成不同时，合计的结论可以和每一组的结论相反。
desc.en: When groups are made up differently, the pooled result can point the opposite way from every group.

zh: 分组都更好合起来更差
分开看都更好合起来更差

desc.zh: 一个检测结果意味着什么，取决于检测之前这件事有多常见。
desc.en: What a test result means depends on how common the condition was before the test.

zh: 检测阳性就一定有病吗
en: does a positive test mean I am sick

desc.zh: 「风险增加 100%」只是一个比值，不知道原来有多大，它几乎什么都没说。
desc.en: 'Risk up 100%' is only a ratio; without the starting risk it says almost nothing.

zh: 降低 50% 风险是什么意思

title.zh: 长尾里的平均数与中位数
title.en: Mean versus median in a long tail

desc.zh: 分布有长尾时，平均数被少数极端值拖走，大多数人低于平均。
desc.en: In a long-tailed distribution a few extreme values drag the mean up, and most people fall below average.

zh: 平均工资为什么那么高
en: Bill Gates walks into a bar

desc.zh: 一个度量变成奖惩的依据后，人们会改善这个数字，不一定改善它原本代表的东西。
desc.en: Once a measure is rewarded, people improve the number, not necessarily the thing it stood for.

en: when a measure becomes a target

title.zh: 拿到一个结论问的六个问题
title.en: Six questions to ask of a conclusion

desc.zh: 先问数字是怎么来到你面前的，再问它说明了什么。
desc.en: First ask how a number reached you, then what it shows.

en: how to read statistics in the news
